name: Injuu Kuma-tan no Gen'ei Vol. 04
source:
Hikari is a girl living in the neighborhood. When we were young, she and I used to play together. But when they grew up we drifted apart.
One day, there is a break from school. That day she showed up in my life again.

This is the start of a heartful sex animal story between the boy and the girl!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE039721.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
光是住在附近的女孩。小時候，我和她經常一起玩。但長大以後，我們就疏遠了。
有一天，學校放假了。那天，她再次出現在我的生活中。

這是男孩和女孩之間一段溫馨的性動物故事的開始！
